comparison.objective: Candidate sets gripper travel; PR-1864 aligns and press-fits a servo horn onto a splined shaft.
comparison.physical_skill: Coupled screw/nut countertorque differs from fine angular registration followed by axial spline insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate verifies locking and cyclic retention; PR-1864 verifies correct spline index, flush seating, stillness, and released clearance.
comparison.reason: Both use angular alignment, but one tests indexed insertion while the other tests preservation of an adjustable stop during locking.
